findings.finding: Home lacks task-oriented Apply/Continue/Staff/Verify entry; generic register/login dominate.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite front door using existing authenticated continuation; do not invent anonymous taxpayer tracking.

findings.finding: Staff default landing has no Inbox card; Applications described as work queue and Treasury Work picks first permitted area, not assigned task.
findings.recommendation: Inbox-first landing/card with existing server task counts; preserve authorized lookup.

findings.finding: Preview-enabled root is the role/laboratory launcher, unsuitable as the normal turnover front door. Exposure is configuration-dependent, not proof of unauthorized access.
findings.recommendation: Chief Architect chooses ordinary turnover entry while keeping private preview safeguards and protected engineering entry.

findings.finding: Welcome ends service at Ready for Authority Review although certified synthetic UAT proceeds to release. Production legal-effect denial remains true.
findings.recommendation: Use environment-accurate lifecycle wording without asserting production authority.

findings.finding: Reports dashboard shortcut opens Daily Collections whereas sidebar opens report catalogue.
findings.recommendation: Make general Reports destination catalogue; retain Daily Collections as named secondary shortcut.

findings.finding: Citizen Start/Continue and Track cards use the same applications index.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into My Applications with clear Start action, not a second tracking system.

findings.finding: Intake fixtures and cleanroom helper are already conditional on show_engineering_controls.
findings.recommendation: Preserve gating, remove from ordinary role journeys; do not call this confirmed ordinary leakage.

findings.finding: Laboratory provisioning is shown in Users & Access when capability allows.
findings.recommendation: Place in separate server-authorized engineering entry, no permission expansion.

findings.finding: Business Permit Evaluator / canonical Evaluation / immutable Assessment wording burdens task understanding.
findings.recommendation: Keep Evaluation and Assessment distinct; plain task label first, technical evidence in details.

findings.finding: Fallback Application page explains living projection/canonical records and Receipt projection.
findings.recommendation: Move architecture to audit/help while preserving amounts and missing evidence.

findings.finding: Void unavailable explains unresolved policy only in title tooltip before submission.
findings.recommendation: Visible concise policy reason; never enable voiding.

findings.finding: Treasury confirmation combines multiple readiness predicates; enterprise hint exists but aggregate failure reason is not adjacent to button.
findings.recommendation: Map existing unmet predicates to concise visible reasons; treat promotion to P0 as role-state browser finding.

findings.finding: ApplicationDocumentNavigator declares tablist/tab but lacks arrow-key handling and explicit panel associations.
findings.recommendation: Verify keyboard behavior; implement accessible tab semantics only in later authorized wave.

findings.finding: Login has positive tabindex values; may reorder passkey and form navigation.
findings.recommendation: Validate natural focus order in 10F; no auth redesign.

findings.finding: Rescue/source/canonical mapping language appears in ordinary history; boundaries must remain.
findings.recommendation: Short read-only boundary, optional audit detail; no historical mapping changes.

findings.finding: 016 overflow table wrapper lacks keyboard focus support present in 004/028.
findings.recommendation: Record future presentation/a11y proposal only; do not change accepted reports in this gate.

findings.finding: Directory links carry report IDs; report pages already have meaningful titles. 028 has separate admission.
findings.recommendation: Names prominent, IDs retained in metadata; no shared entitlement or deployment.

findings.finding: Certification and Mayoral completion link to Application, not explicit Return to Inbox. Global sidebar remains available.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual return only, not a new action or task queue.

findings.finding: Dense document sheets, sticky tabs and financial columns are high risk on 390×844; no new overflow verified in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Test exact viewport, keyboard and no page overflow in 10F/10G before calling pass.

findings.finding: Text identity exists; no authoritative municipal seal found in public asset inventory.
findings.recommendation: MUNICIPAL_ASSET_REQUIRED if seal requested; use existing text identity meanwhile.

findings.finding: Synthetic authority, provisional enterprise bands and historical/report limitations are indispensable.
findings.recommendation: Retain truthful disclosures; no production-readiness implication.

findings.finding: No general analytics needed for role work discovery.
findings.recommendation: Do not add unsupported global counts; optional analytics after turnover.

findings.finding: Repeated architecture explanation can live in optional guide/audit details.
findings.recommendation: Small help hierarchy, not new help platform.

findings.finding: Visual consistency beyond task clarity is optional.
findings.recommendation: No broad document redesign.

findings.finding: Signature capture uses pointer-only canvas; no alternative input in this component. Modal exists but focus/assistive input not certified.
findings.recommendation: Chief Architect must commission accessible facsimile interaction without weakening signature/undertaking evidence. Do not invent statutory signature policy.

findings.finding: Three retained Vue pages are no longer rendered by current controllers; route redirects or Access replacement apply.
findings.recommendation: Keep inventoried as non-routed; no deletion in Gate 10A and do not count as live surfaces.
